Sorry folks I had to RSVP no:
https://quickthoughts.jgregorymcverry.com/2019/02/28/no-dont-fall-the-blockchain-hypereally-whats-it-do-a

If you want to learn how to set up an RSVP and Event system on your own domain let me know...or you can come to
https://indieweb.org/2019/Online or
https://indieweb.org/2019/New_Haven

And now I am trolling your events with out events..tsk...tsk...I'll go look for my keys to my car.... lose those about as much as my wallet...Combining the two...disaster.
